text:
DeployBot: Initiating staged rollout: service=inference-api, model=v2.4.0-rc1, cohort=LATAM, initial=5%, planned bump=20% after validation. Change window: 01:30-02:30 UTC. Command: `/deploy start --service=inference-api --model=v2.4.0-rc1 --staged=5% --bump=20% --window=01:30-02:30`
Carlos: quick note: this build includes a tokenizer tweak that could change token counts for some long prompts. Watch truncation metrics.
Elena: thanks. I'll add a focused eval on long-prompt recall and token_count.delta.
Mei (oncall): holding until we confirm auth and latency baselines. Last night's small latency tail was flakey in LATAM.
Ben (infra): infra observed a slight GC spike on one node family during warmups yesterday. We'll pin to the gc-tuned pool for this canary.
Carlos: prefer start at 1% then escalate to 5%? smaller surface for tokenizer risk.
DeployBot: edit: set initial=1% soak=8m bump=5% then wait 10m before bump to 20%. `/deploy edit --staged=1% --soak=8m --bump=5% --pause=10m`
Mei (oncall): I'll monitor auth.login.latency_p95 and request.latency_p99. If latency_p99 > baseline + 120ms, call stop.
Elena: pinned eval note: "long_prompt_recall.delta" threshold is 1.5%. Will raise if above.
ReleaseNotesBot: auto-add: "v2.4.0-rc1 includes tokenizer adjustments; note potential token-count deltas for long prompts; staged rollout LATAM."
Ben (infra): warming up on gc-tuned pool now. Hotstart throttle=7s.
DeployBot: canary started at 1%. Monitoring hooks: tokenizer.token_count.delta, long_prompt_recall, auth.latency_p95, request.5xx.rate.
TelemetryBot: tokenizer.token_count.delta = +3.2% (warning threshold 3.0%) at 01:31:12 UTC. long_prompt_recall.delta = +0.8%.
Carlos: hmm token_count delta just crossed warning. Is that expected from tokenizer tweak?
Elena: yes partial. It's expected for some long prompts; recall still within threshold. Recommend hold at 1% for full soak.
Mei (oncall): holding. :hand: I'll give go if auth latency_p95 and request.5xx stable for 8m.
Ben (infra): GC pool looks stable. No OOMs, p95 mem steady.
TelemetryBot: auth.latency_p95 = +10ms, request.5xx.rate = 0.04% (baseline 0.03%).
Elena: since recall delta <1.5% and 5xx tiny, propose bump to 5% after soak.
DeployBot: bumping to 5% now. `/deploy bump --staged=5%`
TelemetryBot: after bump: tokenizer.token_count.delta = +3.5% (now above warning) at 01:42:05 UTC. long_prompt_recall.delta = +1.6% (crossed threshold 1.5%).
Carlos: uh-oh recall crossed threshold after 5% bump. Impact: some multi-shot chains losing final context.
Mei (oncall): calling stop. auth latencies still fine but recall regression matters for customers. Stop and rollback to v2.3.0.
Elena: agree. Stop now. Triggering rollback.
DeployBot: stop acknowledged. Executing rollback to model=v2.3.0. `/deploy rollback --service=inference-api --to=model=v2.3.0`
Ben (infra): scaling down v2.4.0-rc1 pods and reinstating v2.3.0. Watch for warmstart traffic bleed for ~60s.
TelemetryBot: post-rollback metrics: long_prompt_recall.delta -> back within -0.1% vs baseline at 01:45:30 UTC. tokenizer.token_count.delta -> +0.2%.
ReleaseNotesBot: add postmortem blurb: "v2.4.0-rc1 staged LATAM halted due to long_prompt_recall regression after 5% bump; rolled back to v2.3.0. Action: revert tokenizer tweak and run extended recall evals before next attempt."
Carlos: I'll open a PR to revert tokenizer tweak and link tests.
Elena: I'll schedule a longer soak run in staging with extended long-prompt suites (2h) before reattempt.
Mei (oncall): thanks team. I'm marking the change window as used and updating incident page. If we want to retry tonight, need green on extended soak and new signoff.
Ben (infra): adding quick runbook snippet to thread:
```
# fast rollback steps
/deploy rollback --service=inference-api --to=model=v2.3.0
kubectl -n inference rollout status deploy/inference-api -w
```
Carlos: noted. Will update release notes to explain why we paused the staged rollout.
DeployBot: thread closed by automation after rollback complete. If follow-up, create new thread."
